prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Create ONE finished Korean academic presentation slide, a single 16:9 landscape image at 2048x1152 if available. NOT a six-panel sheet, NOT a mockup on a desk, no external border.
Image 1 is ONLY the chosen Steel / Sky visual style reference: its six tiles demonstrate a style, not your output layout. Rebuild just the requested individual slide at full size.
STYLE LOCK: #355872 dark steel for text/lines; #7AAACE secondary blue; #9CD5FF sky accents; #F7F8F0 ivory background. Flat clean colors, no extra accent colors. Actual inserted photographs retain natural colors. Match the reference's strong oversized Korean sans-serif headings, thin open diagrams, generous negative space, restrained square corner motifs. Use one consistent Noto Sans KR-like sans family, bold headline around 58px, main text 32-38px at 2048 width, captions at least 23px. Main content left/right margins 110px, heading baseline near y180. One headline and one dominant composition. Slide number small top left. No random English decor, slogans, logos, middle-dot separators, neon, glossy cards, shadows, repetitive rounded cards or stock robot renders. Use commas or slashes.
CONTENT LOCK: render supplied Korean text accurately and keep all numbers/units. Do not add empirical facts, percentages, rankings or unprovided claims. A concept drawing must be labeled 개념도. Do not conflate implemented features with validated mission success. Real image inputs are supporting inserts: preserve their robot pose, actual blocks, colors and boundaries, do not reimagine or synthesize their content. Crop only for readability, retaining the evidence context. No fabricated experimental scenes.
Only the explicitly listed on-screen text should appear. Presenter notes are not to be printed. Use readable large labels, not dense report paragraphs. Produce a clean full-bleed slide.

SLIDE SPECIFICATION:
Ivory background. Title "색과 형상, 영역 조건으로 대상 선택". Top main band is a broad three-step horizontal explanation using simple thin geometry: "HSV 색 후보" → "형상 검사" → "영역 제외". Under each short exact labels: "색 범위 조정", "면적 / 종횡비 / 채움 정도", "지정 영역 내부 / 작업 범위 밖". Lower left: place supplied Image 2 as authentic screenshot WITHOUT inventing detection boxes; caption "작업 영역 등록 화면". Lower right: simple filled square versus long thin border concept drawing labeled "블록과 경계 테이프 구분", and caption "형상 조건 개념도". Bottom small text "검출 결과, 파지 후보와 FK 위치를 웹 뷰어에서 관찰". Number "06". Do not claim measured filter accuracy, speed gains or before/after comparison.
revision_prompt: Edit this one finished 16:9 slide (Image 1) with exactly ONE targeted correction. Keep all Korean text, layout, sizes, palette, lines and diagrams unchanged. Replace ONLY the lower-left photograph with Image 2, the exact authentic workspace-registration screenshot. Copy Image 2 faithfully into the existing rectangle without redrawing any scene content. Crucially KEEP the existing MAGENTA polygon and YELLOW crosses and yellow labels 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 inside the orange tape boundary, precisely as they appear in Image 2. These are genuine original registration overlays, not invented detection boxes. Do not remove the overlays. Keep the real purple arm at bottom, yellow block at bottom left, green block at upper right, orange tape, checkerboard geometry and all existing image details. Do not move any object, warp the scene, or synthesize new block detections. Caption remains exactly "작업 영역 등록 화면". All other slide pixels remain unchanged.
review: Single slide with ivory Steel / Sky composition and requested Korean content.
Initial generation removed genuine registration overlays; image_gen revision restored magenta boundary and yellow slot markers.
No invented detection results or performance metric; authentic registration-screen caption retained.
Robot pose, blocks and orange tape retain original visual arrangement; raster imagegen insertion is not pixel-identical source copying.
